name: matchday-edge
description: Matchday Edge - Mobile-first Football Prediction PWA (Dixon-Coles Poisson & NegBinomial)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build:client && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('client/dist') && !fs.existsSync('dist')){fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});} else if(fs.existsSync('dist') && !fs.existsSync('client/dist')){fs.cpSync('dist', 'client/dist', {recursive:true});}"
